# Ghoulcaller Gisa: Wretched Ranks (upgraded)

- **Format:** Commander (100 cards)
- **Archetype:** Mono-black Zombie tribal aristocrats: lords make the army bigger, Gisa sacrifices big creatures to make many Zombies at once, and death triggers drain opponents and draw cards
- **Played by:** either. Suits whoever enjoys building a huge board and sacrificing their own creatures for value. There is more to keep track of than in Giada.
- **Status:** idea
- **Target bracket:** 2 (Core)
- **Complexity:** 3/5
- **Estimated power:** 5.5 with owned cards only, 6.5 with the buys
- **Configuration:** **Commander** set (builds alongside Giada and Finneas) and the **Commander-season** set (alongside Izzet, Gruul, Rabbits and Vampires).

Gisa turns your own creatures into more Zombies. Sacrifice a 7-power Rotting Regisaur and you get seven 2/2s, and your lords (Death Baron, Lord of the Accursed, Cemetery Reaper and others) make them all bigger. With Vengeful Dead, Undead Augur and friends on the table, every Zombie that dies drains your opponents or draws you cards, so even a board wipe hurts them. It suits a player who likes big armies, graveyard tricks and a satisfying "one more Zombie" snowball. It is still a fair Bracket 2 deck with no infinite combos and no Game Changers.

### Why these buys (in priority order)

1. **1x Rotting Regisaur** (replaces Liliana's Reaver). A 7/6 for 3 mana. Sacrificed to Gisa it makes 7 Zombies, the biggest single upgrade to the commander's plan. You discard a card every upkeep, so feed it to Gisa quickly. The cheapest printing is The List (plst) at ~A$2.39 est; MTGMate lists it at A$4.00 but was out of stock on 2026-09-28. *Also useful in: 60-card Mono-B Zombies (casual upgrade).*
2. **1x Plague Belcher** (replaces Mire Triton). A 5/4 menace Zombie for 3. Its two -1/-1 counters must go on a creature you control, so put them on a token (if that kills a Zombie token, Belcher's own drain triggers). Every other Zombie *you control* that dies drains each opponent for 1, and at 5 power it is good Gisa food. *Also useful in: 60-card Mono-B Zombies.*
3. **1x Liliana, Death's Majesty** (replaces Josu Vess, Lich Knight). A mythic planeswalker for well under A$1 est. +1 makes a Zombie every turn and -3 brings back Grave Titan, Gray Merchant or Rotting Regisaur. Big value per dollar. *Also useful in: 60-card Mono-B Zombies.*
4. **1x Mirkwood Bats** (replaces Reassembling Skeleton). A 2/3 flyer that makes each opponent lose 1 life whenever you create or sacrifice a token. Gisa, Endless Ranks, Army of the Damned and Liliana create tokens; Carrion Feeder, Vampiric Rites and Deadly Dispute trigger it when they sacrifice a token (Dispute's Treasure counts too). It turns the token plan into a drain finisher. *Also useful in: Any black token deck.*
5. **1x Crippling Fear** (replaces Necrotic Hex). A 4-mana sorcery that works as a one-sided wipe here. Name Zombie and every non-Zombie gets -3/-3 until end of turn, which kills opponents' creatures with toughness 3 or less (bigger Angels survive). It is 3 mana cheaper than Necrotic Hex and keeps your army. Gisa (3/4) and Kalitas (3/4) survive it; Ayara, Vengeful Bloodwitch and Mirkwood Bats die unless Bad Moon is out (Bad Moon saves Ayara and the Bats, not the Bloodwitch). *Also useful in: 60-card Mono-B Zombies (sideboard vs go-wide decks).*
6. **1x Infernal Grasp** (replaces Tendrils of Corruption). Instant, 2 mana: destroy any creature, and you lose 2 life. Cheaper than 4-mana Tendrils, though Tendrils gains life and Grasp costs it. *Also useful in: 60-card Mono-B Midrange target, Orzhov/Dimir 60-card decks.*
7. **1x Murderous Rider // Swift End** (replaces Consumed by Greed). Swift End (instant, 3 mana) destroys a creature or planeswalker and you lose 2 life; later you cast the 2/3 lifelink Zombie from exile. Two cards in one. When the Rider dies it goes to the bottom of your library, so it can't be recurred. *Also useful in: 60-card Mono-B Midrange target.*
8. **1x Ravenous Rotbelly** (replaces Desecration Demon). A 4/5 Zombie for 5. When it enters you may sacrifice up to three Zombies (use tokens), and each opponent sacrifices that many creatures of their choice. That is a one-sided multi-edict at a 4-player table, and the sacrifices also trigger Vengeful Dead, Undead Augur, Plague Belcher and Mirkwood Bats. *Also useful in: Commander only (weaker in 1v1).*
9. **1x Unbreathing Horde** (replaces Undead Butler). A 3-mana Zombie that enters with a +1/+1 counter for each *other* Zombie you control and each Zombie card in *your* graveyard, so mid-game it is often 5/5 or bigger. Whenever it would be dealt damage, the damage is prevented and it loses just one counter (Scryfall ruling: one counter no matter how much damage). Great Gisa food. *Also useful in: 60-card Mono-B Zombies.*
10. **1x Graf Harvest** (replaces Cemetery Recruitment). 1 mana: all your Zombies have menace, so they are hard to block when attacking wide. Late game it turns creature cards in the graveyard into 2/2 Zombies. *Also useful in: 60-card Mono-B Zombies.*
11. **1x Archghoul of Thraben** (replaces Sign in Blood). Card advantage that fits the plan. Whenever it or another Zombie you control dies (tokens included), look at your top card: take it if it's a Zombie card (about 1 in 4 cards in this list); otherwise you may mill it, which clears a dead draw and stocks creature cards for Victimize, Liliana's -3 and Memorial to Folly. *Also useful in: 60-card Mono-B Zombies.*
12. **1x Myriad Landscape** (replaces Swamp). A land that later fetches two Swamps: ramp that doesn't take a spell slot, and it adds Swamps for Consuming Corruption. Giada's target also wants one, so buy 2. *Also useful in: Giada target list (buy 2 in total), any Commander deck.*

| Rotting Regisaur | Liliana's Reaver | Medium. Reaver is a fine 4/3 deathtouch but gives Gisa 4 Zombies, not 7, and costs 1 more |
| Plague Belcher | Mire Triton | Small. You lose a 5-power menace body and the drain on Zombie deaths |
| Liliana, Death's Majesty | Josu Vess, Lich Knight | Medium. Josu is a solid 4/5 menace, but his 10-mana kicker rarely happens; Liliana makes a Zombie every turn |
| Mirkwood Bats | Reassembling Skeleton | Medium-small. Vengeful Bloodwitch (in both lists) already drains one opponent per creature death, so the drain plan works without Bats. Skeleton is cheap, recurring sacrifice fodder; Bats adds a flyer that drains *every* opponent for each token made or sacrificed |
| Crippling Fear | Necrotic Hex | Medium. Hex is 7 mana and costs you six creatures too (you get six tapped Zombies back); Fear is 4 mana and one-sided |
| Infernal Grasp | Tendrils of Corruption | Small. Tendrils scales with Swamps but costs 4 |
| Murderous Rider | Consumed by Greed | Small. Greed only hits their biggest creature, not your choice |
| Ravenous Rotbelly | Desecration Demon | Small. Demon is a 6/6 flyer and great Gisa food (it grows each time an opponent sacrifices a creature to tap it), but it isn't a Zombie and opponents can keep it tapped |
| Unbreathing Horde | Undead Butler | Small. Butler gives value; Horde is a huge body for 3 |
| Graf Harvest | Cemetery Recruitment | Small. Recruitment is card advantage; Harvest wins more combats |
| Archghoul of Thraben | Sign in Blood | Very small |
| Myriad Landscape | Swamp | Very small (a little slower ramp) |

The owned list itself already beats the precon. It cuts the weakest 13 precon cards (Ambition's Cost, Commander's Sphere, Eternal Taskmaster, Marchesa's Decree, Mutilate, Noxious Ghoul, Oversold Cemetery, Razorlash Transmogrant, Syphon Flesh, Wight of Precinct Six, Moan of the Unhallowed, Geier Reach Sanitarium, 1 Swamp) for pool cards: Hero's Downfall, Feed the Swarm, Deadly Plot, Eaten Alive, Victimize, Deadly Dispute, Vampiric Rites, Massacre Wurm, Desecration Demon, Reassembling Skeleton, Heraldic Banner, Swiftfoot Boots and Vengeful Bloodwitch. **Noxious Ghoul was cut on purpose.** Every Zombie token entering gives non-Zombies -1/-1, so one big Gisa activation would kill Gisa herself (she's a Human).

**Why Vengeful Bloodwitch instead of Wayfarer's Bauble:** both lists play Vengeful Bloodwitch (owned, 6 copies, 3 spare after the Orzhov Vampires deck) rather than the pool's Wayfarer's Bauble. The Bloodwitch drains a target opponent and gains you 1 life whenever it or another creature you control dies, including tokens. That fits Gisa's sacrifice plan far better than slow land ramp in a 37-land deck, and the life gain offsets Phyrexian Arena, Midnight Reaper and Graveborn Muse. The deck still has 7 mana rocks, plus Myriad Landscape in the target list.

## Notes

### Game plan (in plain words)

1. **Turns 1–4: build up.** Play a land every turn. Cast mana rocks: Sol Ring, Arcane Signet, Mind Stone, the Banners (choose **black** for Heraldic Banner and **Zombie** for Patchwork Banner). Rocks are artifacts that tap for mana; this is called *ramp*. Then cast cheap Zombies and *lords*, creatures that make your other Zombies bigger: Death Baron, Lord of the Accursed, Lord of the Undead, Cemetery Reaper and Undead Warchief.
2. **Turn 4–5: cast Gisa** from the command zone. Her ability: pay {B}, tap her, and *sacrifice* another creature (put it into your graveyard) to create that many 2/2 Zombie tokens, one per point of the sacrificed creature's power. Best food: Rotting Regisaur (7), Unbreathing Horde, Soulless One, Plague Belcher, or any Zombie pumped by your lords. Gisa can't tap on the turn she arrives unless she has Swiftfoot Boots (haste).
3. **Snowball.** Death triggers turn every sacrifice into value:
   - Vengeful Dead, Plague Belcher, Vengeful Bloodwitch and Mirkwood Bats make opponents lose life.
   - Undead Augur (any of your Zombies), Midnight Reaper (nontoken creatures) and Archghoul (a Zombie off the top) draw you cards.
   - Open the Graves (nontoken creatures) and Headless Rider (nontoken Zombies) replace what dies with a 2/2 Zombie.
   - Endless Ranks of the Dead and Liliana make free Zombies.
4. **Win.** Attack with a wide army (Graf Harvest gives them menace, so each one needs two blockers). Finish with Gray Merchant's drain (*devotion* = the number of {B} symbols in the mana costs of your permanents), Mirkwood Bats triggers, or Army of the Damned's 13 Zombies.

### Opening hand and mulligans
- **Keep:** 3–4 lands plus something to do on turns 2–3 (a rock, a 2–3-mana Zombie or a lord). Two lands plus Sol Ring, Arcane Signet or Mind Stone is also fine.
- **Mulligan** (shuffle, draw a new 7, then put 1 card on the bottom for each mulligan you've taken): 0–1 lands, 6–7 lands, or a hand of only 5–8-mana cards.
- In multiplayer your first mulligan is free (Comprehensive Rules 103.5c): draw a new 7 and keep all of them; after that each mulligan puts one card on the bottom.

### Play tips
1. **Gisa works at instant speed.** If she is untapped and an opponent targets your big creature with removal, sacrifice it to Gisa *in response* and you still get the Zombies. The best time to use her is usually at the end of the turn of the player before you, so the tokens can attack on your turn. (This doesn't work against a board wipe, because the new tokens die too.)
2. **Watch your life total.** Graveborn Muse makes you draw X and lose X life *every* upkeep, where X is the number of Zombies you control. With 10 Zombies that's 10 life a turn. The trigger is mandatory and counts tokens, and sacrificing the Muse after the trigger is on the stack doesn't stop it. So sacrifice the Muse (to Gisa, Carrion Feeder or Vampiric Rites) *before* your upkeep when your Zombie count gets high. Phyrexian Arena, Night's Whisper, Midnight Reaper, Undead Augur, Castle Locthwain and several removal spells also cost life; Vengeful Bloodwitch, Ayara, Kalitas and Gray Merchant win some back.
3. **Rotting Regisaur makes you discard every upkeep.** The discard happens at the start of *your* upkeep, so sacrifice it to Gisa before then, ideally at the end of the turn of the player before you (the tokens then untap and can attack). With an empty hand the discard does nothing. Plague Belcher *must* put two -1/-1 counters on one of your creatures, so pick a token.
4. **Don't dump your whole hand into a board wipe.** Keep a lord or a token-maker back. Crippling Fear (name Zombie) and Massacre Wurm are *your* wipes; they mostly kill the other players' creatures. Gisa and Kalitas survive Crippling Fear; Ayara, Vengeful Bloodwitch and Mirkwood Bats die (Bad Moon saves Ayara and the Bats).
5. **Point graveyard effects the right way.** Bojuka Bog exiles a graveyard: target an opponent's, not yours. Your graveyard is a resource for Gravecrawler, Zul Ashur, Victimize, Deadly Plot, Liliana's -3 and Memorial to Folly. Liliana's -7 destroys all non-Zombies, **including Gisa**.

### Watch out for (opponents' cards)
- **Board wipes:** Wrath of God, Austere Command, Cleansing Nova, Farewell, Blasphemous Act, Toxic Deluge. Giada's deck runs Austere Command, Cleansing Nova and Sunblast Angel. Keep cards in hand.
- **Graveyard hate:** Bojuka Bog, Rest in Peace, Soul-Guide Lantern. These shut off your recursion.
- **Flyers:** your Zombies fight on the ground, so Angels fly over them. Answer them with removal, Crippling Fear and Massacre Wurm, and Death Baron's deathtouch blockers.
- **Attack taxes and lifegain:** Archangel of Tithes (makes you pay to attack) and heavy lifegain slow your drain plan.
- **Removal on Gisa:** Swords to Plowshares and similar. Swiftfoot Boots gives her hexproof. If she dies she goes back to the command zone, but she costs {2} more each time (*commander tax*).

### Why this is Bracket 2 (Core)
- 0 Game Changers (checked against the 53-card list and Scryfall).
- No mass land denial and no extra turns.
- No infinite combos: Commander Spellbook found 0 in both lists (checked 2026-09-28).
- No real tutors.

It wins by building a board everyone can see and answer. Tell the table it's an upgraded Wretched Ranks precon at Bracket 2.

**Do NOT add. Each would complete an infinite or game-winning combo with cards already in this deck** (Commander Spellbook find-my-combos, 2026-09-28). Bracket 2 bans intentional 2-card infinites, and the 3-card loops go against its spirit:
- 2-card: Phyrexian Altar (+ Gravecrawler); Plague of Vermin (+ Mirkwood Bats: each opponent loses; or + Ayara).
- 3-card loops: Pitiless Plunderer (+ Gravecrawler + Carrion Feeder), Warren Soultrader (+ Gravecrawler + Ayara or Bontu's Monument), The Ghoul, Gunslinger (+ Gravecrawler + Carrion Feeder), Mikaeus, the Unhallowed (+ Plague Belcher + Carrion Feeder).
- 4-card: Carnival of Souls (+ Ayara + Gravecrawler + Carrion Feeder).
**Also avoid:** Zombie Apocalypse (it destroys all Humans, and Gisa is a Human Wizard). Any Game Changer (Necropotence, Demonic/Vampiric Tutor, Bolas's Citadel, Field of the Dead…) makes the deck Bracket 3. Grave Pact is legal in B2 but feels oppressive at a social table.
